messages:
tom: Argus Bank POC failing validation. Their fncall outputs sometimes have "trade_id": null and their validator rejects. Also hitting 429s during retries. Can we triage?

anya: sending sample payload from them now.

sales-bot: forwarded sample:
{
  "trade_id": null,
  "amount": 5000,
  "status": "PENDING"
}

ryan: quick notes: nulls look tied to streaming boundary + aggressive client retries. Logs show rate_limit hits and schema_violation errors.

infra-bot: log snippet: [2026-03-21T16:10:12Z] req=ef56 model=redwood-2-stream mode=json error=schema_violation field=trade_id; [2026-03-21T16:10:13Z] req=ef56 rate_limit=429 Retry-After=2

anya: customer asks if we can force non-streaming generation for validation runs and add deterministic JSON serialization. They need a short runbook for their CI.

ryan: mitigation plan:
- enable route override: json_mode.stable_key_order=true + json_mode.drop_nulls=true for their validation endpoint
- provide non-streaming endpoint for strict runs
- temporary org qps bump to 450 for 4 hours while they run tests
- advise client to implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After

tom: please push config to canary and I'll ask them to rerun in 15m. Also need a note on whether drop_nulls could hide missing data.

ryan: pushed canary. infra-bot: config-change by ryan for route/argus-poc {"json_mode":{"stable_key_order":true,"drop_nulls":true},"streaming":false} rolling to canary

infra-bot: canary check: 12 validations, 0 schema_violations. Still see a couple of client-side 429 bursts outside canary.

anya: Argus ran validation against canary and passed. They accepted non-streaming for POC. They asked for a short attestation stating we won't persist PII.

tom: follow-ups:
- ryan open INF-9901 to track permanent fix and tests
- anya to draft one-paragraph attestation and attach to POC doc
- sales-bot to send pricing note for temporary dedicated pool (discounted trial)

ryan: INF-9901 created: "Argus POC - streaming JSON nulls and serializer behavior" https://go.redwood/infracase/INF-9901

anya: drafted attestation, sending to customer. Scheduling final run tomorrow 11:00 PT.

tom: thanks team, re-open if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
